salesTax.permit: Tennessee sales and use tax registration

permitFee.note: Registering for a sales and use tax account with the Department of Revenue is free; a separate $15 business license fee is paid to the local clerk.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month or portion of a month the tax is delinquent, up to 25%, with a $15 minimum.

unemployment.note: No current official penalty amount for a late wage report was found in the state agency's published sources.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: The penalty is a multiple of the average yearly premium (two and a half times when coverage was never obtained, one and a half times after the fact), not a stated dollar amount (Tenn. Code 50-6-118).

local.title: City/county business license (Business Tax)
